# Quiver

> Personal surf forecast and community platform for US coasts, Hawaii, and Baja California.

## About

Quiver is a free surf forecasting platform that applies per-beach XGBoost bias correction on top of NOAA WaveWatch III baseline models, trained on 30,000+ buoy observations from CDIP, NDBC, and IOOS. Forecasts are updated every 3 hours across 72 directional bins. The platform combines ML-corrected wave predictions with personalized Match Scores, session tracking, and a community layer where surfers share conditions and sessions.

## Features

- Match Scores: personalized 0-100 surf quality rating per beach that learns from your sessions and preferred conditions
- 7-Day Forecasts: ML-corrected wave height, period, direction, and wind forecasts updated every 3 hours
- Tide Charts: NWS-sourced tide predictions for every beach
- Live Conditions: real-time buoy observations from CDIP, NDBC, and IOOS stations
- Surf Map: interactive map of 185+ beaches with live forecast overlays and filtering by break type and skill level
- Session Tracking: log sessions with auto-prefilled conditions, equipment, and accuracy feedback
- Surf Journal: personal history of sessions with progression analytics
- Community: share sessions and photos, follow local surfers, post crowd and condition reports
- Spot Discovery: 350+ intent-based guide pages for finding breaks by style, skill level, or wave type
- Mobile Apps: native iOS and Android apps with push condition alerts and GPS-based recommendations
- Forecast Methodology: public explanation of buoy checks, wave-height definitions, and comparison limits

## Data Sources

- CDIP (Coastal Data Information Program)
- NDBC (National Data Buoy Center)
- IOOS (Integrated Ocean Observing System)
- NOAA WaveWatch III (global baseline wave model)
- NWS tide predictions
